title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitives. Amounts in USD and prices are decimal strings; times are ISO 8601 UTC.

decimal.description: Signed decimal as a string, e.g. "-4.60". Never a JSON number, to avoid float rounding.

utcTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC with a Z suffix, e.g. 2026-11-06T09:30:00Z.

pair.description: ETH/USDC only; multi-asset support is out of scope.
